newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Metalcorp pays A$31 million for Wanless.
newsitem.headline: Metalcorp pays A$31 million for Wanless.

text.p: Metalcorp Ltd said on Tuesday that it had completed the A$31 million purchase of unlisted metals recycler Wanless Metal Industries, based in the state of Queensland.

The company, which made its agreed bid after Simsmetal Ltd was blocked from proceeding with an offer by the anti-monopolies body, said the purchase price mostly consisted of shares with a small cash element.
It said it would issue 14.5 million shares at A$1.75 each to Wanless, representing A$25.375 million, with the rest in cash.
The shares, set at the market price prior to the regulator's ruling, would not be entitled to a dividend in the current half year.
Metalcorp shares ended four cents higher at A$2.39.
